messages:
Carmen (CS): onboarding check-in with Apexera this am. they like throughput but raised 3 items that could sway renewal. dropping raw notes here.
Dev (CSM): TL;DR: Finance needs campaign-level cost splits; ops ran into duplicate downstream writes due to client retries; product wants clearer per-route latency percentiles. risk = medium.
Carmen (CS): Apexera asks (verbatim):
- campaign tagging for cost reconciliation (header or metadata)
- optional server-side webhook retry with idempotency header + DLQ
- per-route p50/p95 latency in console or export
Carmen (CS): they included this curl they reproduced when duplicates occurred:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.apexera.co/e -H "X-Campaign: q3-blitz" -H "X-Idempotency: 0a1b2c" -d '{"route":"score","user":123}'
```
Ryo (Eng): quick read: cheapest win = header passthrough and include campaign in usage export CSV (~1 sprint). per-route percentiles can reuse metrics pipeline (~1 sprint). server-side retry + idempotency + DLQ is heavier; estimate 2-3 sprints to do safely.
Isha (PM): proposal: do campaign-export MVP first to relieve CFO pressure, then metrics, then retries. Carmen can you create a ticket with acceptance criteria and sample CSV by EOD so we can commit?
Carmen (CS): on it. acceptance criteria I'll include: header name (`X-RW-Campaign`), CSV column `campaign_name`, sample rows from pilot, doc snippet and example curl.
support-bot: created RW-7900 "campaign-tagging export MVP" assigned to Product: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-7900 :white_check_mark:
Dev (CSM): I'll communicate timeline to Apexera and ask their CFO to validate sample CSV once ticket has draft.
Ryo (Eng): I'll add a short tech note in RW-7900 about header passthrough and telemetry changes; will also draft idempotency/DLQ constraints in a follow-up ticket.
Isha (PM): Ryo, can you post idempotency format + DLQ retention estimate by Thu so we can scope the retries work?
Carmen (CS): thanks team, I'll post updates after ticket grooming. closing loop for now. :pray:
